messages:
sophia: Thanks everyone for the great attendance today — quick follow-up thread to capture asks, owners, and links. I'll list the top asks from Q&A and we can assign owners.

matt: key one from infra — Dedicated GA latency SLOs and expected capacity numbers pls.

jana: sliding in the slides link: https://redwood.ai/slides/all-hands-march24 (see slide 18 for Dedicated targets).

devin: paraphrasing ops question — will Dedicated support multi-tenant routing with strict isolation? TL;DR: yes, separate pools + network policies. Engineering doc linked below.

lia: can we get a clearer migration path for existing hosted customers to Dedicated? asked on behalf of a few larger customers.

sophia: good ask @lia — action: create a migration checklist + pricing appendix. owner: @lia. due: 2024-04-05.

matt: action: infra to publish latency SLO doc and expected p50/p95 per model class. owner: @matt. due: 2024-03-29.

jana: action: product to draft Dedicated migration checklist + customer-facing FAQ. owner: @jana. due: 2024-04-05. I added a stub RFC: https://redwood.ai/rfc/dedicated-migration-v1

devin: ops question about billing cadence for Reserved vs burst — finance to confirm whether Reserved pools invoice monthly or quarterly. owner: @devin. due: 2024-03-28.

lia: small ask from support: sample support playbook for failed rollouts (canary fallback) would help CS. owner: @lia + @matt. due: 2024-04-02.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled: shared infra meeting to review Dedicated kernels on 2024-03-27 14:00 UTC.

matt: noted — I'll bring the profiling numbers and canary rollback flow.

jana: follow-ups I'll own: customer comms draft + FAQ. Posting draft in #docs tomorrow.

devin: I'll loop in finance and paste invoice samples here when I have them.

lia: quick note: assign a primary contact for enterprise trials — volunteers? @jana?

sophia: @jana happy to have you own trials contact for initial cohort. we'll rotate if load grows.

matt: linking the technical SLO tracker: https://redwood.ai/trackers/slo-dedicated (internal).

jana: Added action items to short Trello board (internal): https://trello.com/b/redwood/ah-followups. please add comments/estimates.

devin: FYI — I'll open ticket INFRA-4123 for the latency SLO work and tag @matt.

lia: putting a reminder: I'll prepare a one-pager for CS playbook and share by EOD 2024-04-02.

sophia: thanks all. two asks for leadership: (1) if anything blocks you from your due dates, mention now; (2) if you want exec help engaging a customer pilot, ping me.

matt: no blocks yet. may ask for a GPU perf blob from infra team next week.

jana: no blocks. will need comms review from legal for pricing appendix — looping in legal today.

devin: finance is swamped but aiming for due date. might slip by 1 day if we need approvals.

lia: will hit due date; will ask for support templates from support lead today.

sophia: perfect. I'll compile these into a single follow-up doc and post in #company-updates by Monday. thanks :clap:
